headline: SEA @ BAL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SEA 3.66 at BAL 3.39, with a projected total of 7.05. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward BAL: SEA moved -0.91 runs while BAL moved +0.02, changing the projected margin by -0.93 runs. The projected total fell -0.88, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +20.2%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Kyle Bradish has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Josh Naylor, Pete Alonso, Cole Young, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Samuel Basallo, Patrick Wisdom because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
